messages:
sarah.k: quick heads-up — when querying /api/v1/projects/alpha/members we saw members from org:b-123 in the list.

sarah.k: sample response:
```json
{"project_id":"alpha","members":[{"user_id":"u-789","org_id":"b-123","role":"viewer"}]}
```

sarah.k: This should never include org_id b-123. I think resolution is walking group memberships and following 'parent_org' links.

aj: I think PR #482 (membership-service) changed fallback to resolve via org_path. Rolling it back now.

liz_chen: logs from membership-resolver: `WARN membership: resolved via org_path for group g-55` — trace_id=0a1b2c

michael: temporary mitigation: set ENV STRICT_ORG_CHECK=true on membership-resolver in staging then prod canary. Also revoke any KMS key grants added for the service last week.

security-bot: [alert] Created incident INC-2026-453 (membership-leak). Assigned: eng-security + eng. Severity: P2. Audit logging flagged 12 cross-org resolves in last 24h.

aj: rolling back PR, deploying patch in 5m. I'll also add org_id strict equality in the resolver.

sarah.k: pls add audit-log query for `member_resolution_path` and list all affected projects. need to notify CS if externally visible.

liz_chen: running query now — found 9 projects affected, mostly internal test projects; 2 customer projects show unusual member entries. sending list to sec-scrub.

michael: follow-up: check KMS policies for membership-token keys. There was a grant to service-account:membership-service@infra — might be broader than intended.

sarah.k: OK, action items: (1) aj rollback and patch (2) michael adjust KMS grants + rotate key if found overbroad (3) liz run audit export and redact PII (4) security team to open customer-notification plan. Target: rollback + audit within 2 hours.

aj: patch deployed, canary looks good. reverting change that followed org_path. monitoring.

security-bot: incident INC-2026-453 updated: mitigation in progress, status: investigating -> contained.

sarah.k: thanks — will follow up with postmortem and RBAC policy PR to add unit tests around org/project boundaries.
